name: Kenjo HR
description: Read Kenjo HR data: employees with names, job titles and reporting lines, companies, offices, departments and teams, time-off requests and types, attendance entries and recruiting positions. Read-only, through the Kenjo API v1.
instructions:
Kenjo is an HR platform. This adapter reads employees, the organisation structure, time off, attendance and recruiting positions through the Kenjo API v1. It never writes.

**Getting credentials**
1. API access is off by default: Kenjo Customer Success must enable it for your account. Request it through Kenjo support.
2. An admin then opens **Settings > Integrations > API** (gear icon in the left menu, then the settings of the API box) and clicks **Generate new API key**. Copy the key at once: Kenjo shows it only once. Up to 5 keys per organisation.
3. Employee data is always included in a key. Switch on attendance, time off and recruiting for the key if you want those tools. Put the key in `KENJO_API_KEY`.

The connector exchanges the key at `POST /auth/login` for a bearer token and renews it by itself. Editing, regenerating or deleting the key in Kenjo invalidates its tokens. The adapter calls the production API `api.kenjo.io`; a sandbox key does not work there.

**Where to start**
- `kenjo_list_employees`: every employee with `_id`, e-mail, name, job title and company, office and department ids. Use it to find a person's `_id`.
- `kenjo_get_employee`: all sections of one employee. This adapter removes the financial section (bank and tax ids).
- Turn ids into names with `kenjo_list_companies`, `kenjo_list_offices`, `kenjo_list_departments` and `kenjo_list_teams`.

**Formats and gotchas**
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. Time-off requests take a `from`/`to` range of at most 92 days, attendances at most 31 days.
- Ids are 24-character hex strings, e.g. `60f0a916214987256be9c8ff`.
- A 403 on attendance, time off or recruiting means that collection is not enabled for the key.

**Pagination and rate limits**: positions, time-off requests and time-off types are paginated. `limit` is 25, 50 or 100 (default 50); `offset` is the page number, starting at 1. The answer carries `metadata.total`: raise `offset` until you have them all. Other lists come back whole. Kenjo publishes no rate limit; on a 429, wait before retrying.

**Cloud reachability**: `api.kenjo.io` is a public HTTPS endpoint, reachable from AnythingMCP Cloud and from self-hosted instances alike.

KENJO_API_KEY.label: Kenjo API key
KENJO_API_KEY.help: Generated by a Kenjo admin under Settings > Integrations > API after Kenjo Customer Success has enabled API access. Shown only once.

verifyHints.401: Kenjo rejected the API key. Check that it was copied whole, that it was not regenerated or deleted since, and that it is a production key (sandbox keys do not work on api.kenjo.io).
verifyHints.403: The API key does not include this collection. Edit the key under Settings > Integrations > API and enable it.

tools.name: kenjo_list_employees
tools.description: List all Kenjo employees with their _id, e-mail, first and last name, display name, job title, active status and company, office and department ids. No parameters; use it to find a person's _id and to check the API key.

tools.name: kenjo_get_employee
tools.description: Get every section of one Kenjo employee: account (e-mail, active), personal (name, birthdate, nationality), work (job title, start date, company, office, department, teams, manager in reportsToId), work schedule, address, home, emergency contact and, when the key allows it, confidential exit data. Bank and tax details are removed.

tools.name: kenjo_list_employee_accounts
tools.description: List Kenjo employee accounts (_id, e-mail, external id, language, active status). Filter by e-mail or external id to look up one person, or by active status to list leavers.

email.description: Kenjo e-mail address of the employee, exact match.

externalId.description: External id of the employee, as set in Kenjo.

isActive.description: True for active employees, false for deactivated ones.

tools.name: kenjo_list_employee_work_details
tools.description: List the work section of every employee: job title, start date, employee number, company, office, department, area and team ids, manager (reportsToId), contract end and probation end. Filter by department, office, company, manager or job title, e.g. to list a team or an org chart.

reportsToId.description: Employee _id of a manager: returns that person's direct reports.

tools.name: kenjo_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (legal entities) set up in Kenjo with _id, name, city and country. Use it to turn the companyId of an employee or office into a name.

tools.name: kenjo_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments set up in Kenjo with _id and name. Use it to turn the departmentId of an employee or position into a name.

tools.name: kenjo_list_offices
tools.description: List the office locations in Kenjo with _id, name, company id, holiday calendar id, street, postal code, city and country. Filter by company, city or name.

tools.name: kenjo_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams set up in Kenjo with _id and name. Use it to turn the teamIds of an employee into names.

tools.name: kenjo_list_time_off_types
tools.description: List the time-off types of the organisation (vacation, sick leave and so on) with _id and name. Paginated with limit and offset; needs the time-off collection enabled on the API key.

tools.name: kenjo_list_time_off_requests
tools.description: List time-off requests in a date range of at most 92 days, with employee id, type id, policy, status, from/to, duration and per-day split. Filter by employee, type or status, e.g. to see who is absent next week or what is waiting for approval. Paginated with limit and offset; check metadata.total.

from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

to.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days after from.

userId.description: Only this employee's requests: the employee _id.

timeOffTypeId.description: Only this time-off type: _id from kenjo_list_time_off_types.

tools.name: kenjo_list_attendances
tools.description: List attendance (worked time) entries of all employees in a date range of at most 31 days: employee id and e-mail, start and end time, breaks, attendance category and comment. Needs the attendance collection enabled on the API key.

from.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-01.

to.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 31 days after from.

tools.name: kenjo_list_positions
tools.description: List recruiting positions (job openings) with _id, job title, company, office and department ids, position type, status and job description. Filter by status or organisation unit. Paginated: limit 25, 50 or 100 and offset as a page number from 1; check metadata.total.
